credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Per Tish Frank, left to right, Tish Frank, Marshall Gerard, Georgia O'Keeffe, Kenny Ross, Doris Bry in Trapper's Canyon where two hermits lived only one mile apart and never spoke to each other.  This photograph is from the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Georgia O'Keeffe and Others in Trapper's Canyon
